sections.Profile:
The player races Sonic through seven Zones from the Sega series, from Green Hill to Rooftop Run, chasing Rings, collecting Chaos Emeralds and battling Dr. Eggman at the end of each. Steve Ritchie designed it for Jersey Jack Pinball as his second and last game there, released in June 2026, with a magnetic accelerator loop, a Spin Dash button and a soundtrack featuring Slash and Jun Senoue.
